_comment: Hand-maintained public-record links for the accountants on PARTNERS.md, keyed by the exact reviewer string the guides carry in reviewed_by or verified_by. scripts/build-partners.py joins them onto the roster it derives from index.json; a key that matches no accountant-reviewed guide is reported and ignored. public_record is a profile or a review diff, label is its link text, note is shown under the roster. Licence numbers do not belong here.
